data.text: How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
data.subtitulo: For the music leader. A psalm of David.

data.text: How long must I wrestle with my thoughts, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy rise above me?
Look and answer me, LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death,
lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I stumble.
But I have trusted in your steadfast love; my heart will rejoice in your salvation.
I will sing to the LORD, for he has dealt generously with me.
